svg.aria-label: Exactly-once message processing inside one database. A consumer receives message 42 from the broker. In a single database transaction it applies the effect, for example adding to a balance, and inserts message ID 42 into a processed-messages table, then commits and only then acknowledges the broker. If the message is delivered again, the insert of 42 conflicts or the lookup finds it, so the effect is skipped.
